description: This PHP source file defines the Pagination class within the Opencart\-Catalog\Controller\Common namespace. The class provides functionality to generate pagination data for views, including handling page links, previous/next controls, and URL formatting, used for navigating through paginated content in an OpenCart e-commerce application.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating pagination controls for product listing pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates pagination data based on provided settings such as total items, current page, limit per page, and URL template. It returns the rendered HTML view for pagination controls or an empty string if pagination is unnecessary.
